original_context: Shepard does not appreciate the local culture.
Shepard does not mentor young people.
Shepard does not make a positive impact.
Anyone who supports their local community either appreciates the local culture or mentors young people (or both).
If Shepard has a big heart and values community, then he dedicates his life to others.
Everyone who dedicates their life to others either makes a positive impact or volunteers regularly (or both).
Everyone who donates their time either helps those in need or supports their local community (or both).
If someone volunteers regularly and helps those in need, then they serve others.
For anyone who serves others and has found their purpose, they will feel fulfilled.
Shepard has either found his purpose or given back to his community (or both).
conclusion: Shepard has given back to his community.
